core_obligations: By the reduce-to-field lemma it suffices to handle k -> Lambda with Lambda Noetherian and geometrically regular over k.
Factor k -> A -> Lambda with A a finite type k-algebra; it suffices to construct a factorization A -> B -> Lambda with h_B = Lambda, which the final-solve lemma converts into a smooth factorization.
Noetherian induction on the ideal h_A: pick a prime q minimal over h_A and resolve k -> A -> Lambda superset q.
The resolution follows from the resolve-special lemma in characteristic zero and from the resolve-general lemma in characteristic p > 0; induction finishes.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to fields; induction frame; resolution at a minimal prime; characteristic case split.
